verdict.rationale: Evidence shows official OS compatibility listings (RHEL, Ubuntu) and community-confirmed AVX-512 support, suggesting baseline OS/tooling recognition, but there is no evidence of AMD-specific compiler optimization guides, toolchain documentation, or first-class developer tooling status. Missing for 10: official compiler/optimization guidance (GCC/LLVM tuning docs), developer-targeted architecture manuals, and independent confirmation of tooling maturity beyond basic OS support.
